WOODWORK — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and equipment.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand Tools and equipment.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and equipment.

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU
